subject: Consistent look and feel of licenses (#1788)
reason: The change (PR #1788, 'Consistent look and feel of licenses') only rewrites license header comments in source files and the COPYING text file: it adds/normalizes SPDX-License-Identifier lines and copyright comment blocks. Every added or removed line in the diff is comment text or whitespace inside comment blocks; no executable code, configuration, protocol, or build logic changes. The compiled binaries are behaviorally identical to the parent, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
